incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated-EU2: reserved customer inference throughput degraded and elevated p99 since 11:10 UTC. Some reserved routes returning 429/504 under steady load. Impact: ~5-8% of Dedicated tenant requests. Mitigation actions in progress. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2391234567

rory.sre: seeing sustained queue growth on shard-reserve-7 after the placement reshuffle at 11:05. scheduler is packing hot tenants onto a small subset of nodes.

maggie.eng: confirmed placement controller changed balancing heuristic to prefer bin-packing for GPU utilization. we underestimated peak per-tenant concurrency.

leo.sme: what symptoms for customers? are tokens failing or are we returning overload responses?

nina.support: customer reports include increased latencies, occasional 429 rate-limits, and timeout 504 for long-running batches. affected tenants: reserved-{alpha,beta,gamma}.

rory.sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause placement-reshard job (11:18 UTC), 2) trigger manual spread for hot tenants, 3) temporarily spin up extra reserved nodes to absorb backlog. doing 1 now.

maggie.eng: paused reshuffle job at 11:19 UTC. starting manual eviction + spread for reserved-{alpha,beta} at 11:22. will avoid preempting other customers.

rory.sre: scaling reserved pool +3 nodes at 11:24 UTC. expected capacity to reduce queue depth in ~5-10m.

leo.sme: can we add per-tenant fairness cushions so autoscaler doesn't collapse under burst? file a follow-up fix please.

maggie.eng: yes adding a temporary per-tenant concurrency cap and a scheduler soft-limit. patch queued; will land after immediate mitigation.

carter.pm: drafting customer message: "We observed degraded throughput for a subset of Dedicated tenants in EU2 due to a placement reshuffle that concentrated work on certain hosts. Mitigation underway; no data loss. We'll follow up with a postmortem." OK to publish once we hit stable window?

nina.support: publish short note now to impacted customers, route to account teams.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Error/429/504 rates falling; p99 trending down to baseline at 11:45 UTC. Mitigation summary: paused placement reshuffle, manual spread of hot tenants, temporary capacity + per-tenant caps. No customer data loss. Postmortem scheduled 2026-04-01 15:00 UTC in #incidents-postmortems. Runbook: https://status.redwood.ai/runbooks/dedicated-placement-imbalance

carter.pm: thanks team. please add timeline + exact placement diff to the postmortem doc and owners: rory.sre (ops timeline), maggie.eng (root cause + scheduler fix), nina.support (customer comms). :white_check_mark:
